SpaceX — Explore the Universe in Virtual Reality

Discover the wonders of the cosmos with SpaceX, an immersive educational VR experience developed by Almavue. Explore galaxies, planets, nebulae, and cosmic portals in a captivating three-dimensional environment designed for students, space enthusiasts, and curious minds.
